projects.name: Pharos
projects.tagline: Distributed uptime monitoring with real-time incident detection and email alerts.
bullets: Built a producer/consumer distributed system — a message queue coordinates an API and a worker process running HTTP checks against user-configured URLs on repeating schedules.
Implemented incident state detection with a 3-consecutive-failure debounce to prevent alert flapping; incidents auto-open and auto-resolve from check history.
Designed public shareable status pages with 30-day uptime calculations, live-refreshing without page reloads via Next.js server components + companion client refreshers.
IDOR-safe API — every ownership check is embedded in the query itself instead of a separate check-then-act flow.

projects.name: Devscribe
projects.tagline: Automated code documentation using LLM analysis with intelligent caching.
bullets: LLM-powered tool that generates documentation for entire codebases by chunking + prompting.
SHA-256 based caching skips unchanged files; sliding-window rate limiting stays within API quotas.

projects.name: Viora
projects.tagline: Meeting transcription + summarization with RAG over past meetings.
bullets: Transcribes meetings via Whisper and Sarvam AI, with Indic language support.
Extracts action items and decisions via LangChain; stores them in ChromaDB for retrieval-augmented Q&A over past meetings.

skills.footnote: Comfortable across the stack. Deepest in TypeScript + distributed systems, plus applied AI.

bullets: Developed and maintained uroflyintl.com to live customer traffic over a 12-week Agile cycle by architecting the end-to-end stack (Next.js 15, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL) as a core contributor.
Delivered browse, cart, and checkout flows responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop by building a reusable React + TypeScript component system with Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Zustand, and Vite.

Powered the full catalog → cart → checkout order lifecycle for a live storefront by designing RESTful APIs on Node.js/Express against a normalized PostgreSQL schema with auth and transactional integrity.
Delivered fast, SEO-friendly product pages verified via Lighthouse audits by implementing Next.js SSR/ISR and deploying with GitHub-based CI/CD for continuous production releases.

Shipped multiple client-facing websites end-to-end following Agile sprint cycles by building full-stack features across React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS alongside senior engineers.

Reduced design-to-code handoff time by pairing directly with designers to translate Figma mockups into pixel-accurate, responsive React components validated across mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints
